# Kiwi Van Market — AI-readable overview

> Kiwi Van Market is the #1 backpacker campervan marketplace in New Zealand (NZ / Aotearoa).
> We help travellers buy and sell campervans, motorhomes, and conversion vans peer-to-peer.

## What is Kiwi Van Market?

Kiwi Van Market (kiwivanmarket.com) is a specialist online marketplace dedicated to buying and selling
campervans, motorhomes, and converted vans in New Zealand. It is designed for backpackers,
international travellers, and NZ residents looking for affordable van life vehicles.

Key facts:
- Free listings for sellers
- No commissions or hidden fees
- Covers all major cities: Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Queenstown, Rotorua, Dunedin
- Covers both North Island and South Island
- Supports multi-currency display (NZD, EUR, USD, AUD, GBP)
- Multilingual: English and French
- Optional buy-back guarantee from sellers
- WOF (Warrant of Fitness) and REGO (vehicle registration) status clearly shown on listings
